text:
maria: Heads-up: starting a light canary for v3.2-int4 (cohort-autothrottle). Want a quick sanity check on the liftback/autofallback rules before we route any traffic.

maria: plan is 2% traffic, split across three seq-len cohorts (short/medium/long). auto-throttle engaged for long prompts only.

eval_bot: smoke results in staging: 2k samples, overall MRR delta -0.6%, hallucination rate +0.3pp, latency p95 +48ms on int4 vs baseline v3.1-fp16.

tom: can you paste the cohort breakdown? especially for long prompts.

ashok: short: 58% samples, MRR delta -0.2%, p95 +12ms; medium: 33%, MRR -0.5%, p95 +30ms; long: 9%, MRR -3.1%, p95 +220ms. Long cohort is 90th+ token projects.

katie: ok the long cohort is the danger. Does the auto-throttle hit hard on long? current config was conservative.

maria: current throttle config we used in staging:
```json
{
  "auto_throttle": true,
  "max_inflight": 250,
  "seqlen_buckets": {
    "short": {"max_tokens": 128, "weight": 0.6},
    "medium": {"max_tokens": 512, "weight": 0.3},
    "long": {"min_tokens": 513, "weight": 0.1, "throttle_factor": 0.5}
  },
  "fallback_policy": {"mrr_drop_pct": 1.5, "max_duration_minutes": 30, "grace_sample_count": 200}
}
```

ashok: two notes: (1) fallback_policy mrr_drop_pct is too loose for long cohort, want 0.8% for long-only, (2) throttle_factor 0.5 for long still allowed many concurrent requests because long requests hold GPUs longer — better to reduce max_inflight for long.

tom: suggestion: introduce cohort-specific max_inflight and an emergency clamp if p95 latency for long > 150ms over baseline. e.g. long.max_inflight=30, clamp= true.

katie: agreed. Also add automatic roll-back metric: if hallucination rate increases >0.5pp in 15m window, immediate 100% fallback to v3.1. Need to avoid noisy short blips.

maria: updated config I propose:
```json
{
  "seqlen_buckets": {
    "short": {"max_inflight": 180},
    "medium": {"max_inflight": 60},
    "long": {"max_inflight": 30, "throttle_factor": 0.35, "latency_clamp_ms": 150}
  },
  "fallback_policy": {"global_mrr_drop_pct": 1.5, "long_mrr_drop_pct": 0.8, "hallucination_pp_increase": 0.5, "window_minutes": 15},
  "promote_rules": {"min_cohort_samples": 500, "observation_hours": 12, "max_promote_pct_per_hour": 5}
}
```

eval_bot: applying new staging config... run started (job 20231014-01).

ashok: one more small ask: add a quiet-burn period (no more than 0.5% per 10m, ramp only after 2h stable) to avoid oscillation.

maria: good call. I'll fold quiet-burn into promote_rules.

tom: decision? Hold promotion to wider until we see long cohort MRR delta <= -1.0% and long p95 within +120ms for 2 consecutive hours. Otherwise keep at 2% and tighten clamp.

katie: +1 to hold. Also let's add an explicit canary alert to #incidents if fallback triggers.

maria: action items: (1) update canary config per above, (2) run 4h extended smoke in staging, (3) alert hook to incidents on fallback. I'll post updated config to the runbook.

maria: thanks team, will iterate and report back in ~3h. :thumbsup:
